description: Agent self-serve API key issuance. An autonomous agent that has no email inbox can obtain a free-tier API key by proving it holds the MACHINE_MINT_SECRET via HMAC-SHA256. Returns a usable key immediately with no human action required. If the operator has not activated a mint secret on the server, this returns an honest not_configured failure rather than a key - call it once and branch on that before planning around it. [free, no key]
